title: GPT-4 Jailbreaks Itself with Near-Perfect Success Using Self-Explanation
reasoning: The paper introduces a technical methodology (IRIS) for jailbreaking large language models by bypassing safety filters. While the filters being attacked are designed to enforce safety and ethical guidelines, the research focuses on adversarial robustness and the security mechanism of the model rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morality, or religion as standalone subjects.
